title: reliquary media definition
description: Synchronized companion to the media specification (media-spec.md), which remains normative. This schema covers the per-document structural subset of the format checks: schema validity never implies definition validity — library-wide name uniqueness, cross-definition archive agreement, defaults derived from URL file-name components, and every resolution rule live in the specification only. One schema covers both homes of a definition: the library .rlqm file (JSONC — comments and trailing commas are invisible at this level) and the JSON island of a script's embedded media block (strict JSON). Definitions carry no $schema field pre-beta; editors bind this schema to *.rlqm by file association.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256, sibling-scoped: next to archive it verifies the archive, inside an item it verifies that item's payload file. Either case is accepted; canonical writes use lowercase.

url.description: Where to download from: a single URL, or a list of mirror URLs that are alternates for the identical artifact — the hashes are the arbiter, not the URL.

itemName.description: The item's name — the string machine drives reference. Defaults to the item's file name with its extension dropped. Must be unique across all definitions (a rule beyond this schema). The name grammar is deliberately open pre-asset-spec.

bareFileName.description: A bare file name — no directories.

fileExtension.description: Overrides the extension taken from file for the cached payload name — for sources whose original name misidentifies (or omits) the type. Written without the leading dot.

localPath.description: A local path for the file, in place of the cache. Download, extraction, and sha256 verification behave exactly as in the cache, just at this path; clean never touches it. Relative paths resolve from the definition file's directory (or the containing script's).

descriptionField.description: A one-line human description of the definition, read into listings and search.

notesField.description: Free-form prose: provenance, licensing context, why a particular mirror. reliquary never interprets it.

itemForm.description: Item form — one definition, one item: the URL points at the media image itself and the download lands directly in the media cache. A payload that arrives inside an archive always uses the archive form.

file.description: The payload's original file name — what the source calls it. Optional when derivable from local-path or the url's file-name component (mirrors ending in different names have no single default — a rule beyond this schema).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the payload file, verified on every use.

archiveForm.description: Archive form — one definition per source archive, itemizing the payload files it contributes. Selected by the items key.

archive.description: The archive's file name in the downloads cache, and the shared key when several definitions reference one archive. Optional when derivable from local-path or the url's file-name component (mirrors ending in different names have no single default — a rule beyond this schema).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the archive, verified before any extraction.

local-path.description: A local path to the archive file, in place of the downloads cache — for archives that cannot be downloaded or that already live in a managed folder.

items.description: The payload files this archive contributes, each named and hash-pinned.

file.description: The payload's original file name. Required in items entries without local-path.

path.description: The path of the payload inside the archive. Defaults to file.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the payload file, verified on every use.
